_meta.description: Per-sector unit-economics benchmarks from published industry research. Replaces a generated file in which ltv_estimate was exactly 10x cac_estimate for every sector, churn was a flat 0.05 and break_even_months a flat 24 - constants that gave the appearance of sector differentiation while providing none.

fields.reference_cac_usd: Median CAC in USD for the cited segment. Reference only - the app computes CAC from the user's own budget and does not read this field.
fields.basis: Which published segment the figures are taken from, and where a proxy was used because no figure is published for this sector.

_meta.caveat: These are industry medians, not measurements of any specific venture. A pre-revenue startup has no observed churn or CAC; these describe what comparable companies report.

ai.basis: B2B SaaS, self-serve / product-led growth segment.

tech.basis: B2B SaaS, self-serve / product-led growth segment.

e-commerce.basis: Direct-to-consumer ecommerce; churn from subscription-box DTC, which reports 7-10% monthly.
e-commerce.source: Klipfolio DTC Benchmarks; Recurly churn research

edtech.basis: EdTech SaaS, the highest-churn vertical measured. LTV:CAC uses the 3.0 cross-industry consensus floor, as no EdTech-specific ratio is published.
edtech.source: RetentionCheck churn benchmarks; Userpilot CAC benchmarks

fintech.basis: Consumer fintech. B2B fintech CAC is far higher (median USD 3,160).

healthcare.basis: Regulated verticals (healthcare IT, legal tech) churn 30-50% below horizontal SaaS on high switching costs; 2.1% is the midpoint of that reduction applied to the 3.5% SaaS median. No healthcare-specific CAC is published.

gaming.basis: Mobile gaming CAC is published; churn and LTV:CAC are not, so churn uses the consumer-app range and the ratio uses the 3.0 consensus floor. Treat both as placeholders, not measurements.

foodtech.basis: PROXY: no foodtech-specific benchmark is published, so this uses direct-to-consumer ecommerce, the nearest measured category.

logistics.basis: PROXY: B2B services / agency segment, the nearest measured category to logistics.

energy.basis: PROXY: no energy/cleantech unit-economics benchmark is published. Uses the 3.0 cross-industry consensus floor and a long payback reflecting capital intensity. The weakest-supported entry in this file.
